tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: List or search Transcend documentation. Prefer route for a Dashboard page, product for a product area, or query for full-text search. Rows may include a one-line index description. section lists one llms.txt section; omit arguments for section names. Then call docs_fetch with a url.

route.description: Admin Dashboard route pattern, path, or app URL. Returns linked pages, then product docs. Combine with query. Not with section or product.

product.description: List docs for one product, overview pages first. One of: Assessments, Classification, Consent Management, Data Inventory, DSR Automation, Platform, Preference Management, Privacy Center, System Discovery, Web Auditor (case-insensitive). Can combine with query. Not with section or route.

section.description: List the articles in this llms.txt section (exact match). Omit both arguments to see the available section names.

query.description: Full-text search terms (prefer 2–3 distinctive words). At most 20 results; no paging.

integration.description: Public integration guides for this catalog integrationName. Catalog depth needs docs_integration_lookup when signed in.

tools.name: docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch full markdown content for a Transcend documentation article by URL. Use urls returned by docs_list.

url.description: Absolute https URL of a docs.transcend.io article (.md) from docs_list.

tools.name: docs_integration_lookup
tools.description: Signed-in catalog docs for one integration (connection, datapoints, actions). Pass integrationName or title; near miss returns close names. Public guides: docs_list.

integration.description: Catalog integrationName (e.g. `salesforce`) or title. Near miss returns close names.
